The reactive wiring is wrong: a task both depends on and writes back to the same reactive state, so during server-side rendering the computed total is not correctly produced/serialized and/or the component spins in a re-run loop, and the auto-restock timer keeps running after it is switched off. Toggling it applies / removes the 10% discount.   - `qty-keyboard`, `qty-mouse`, `qty-monitor`: element whose text content is that item\'s current integer quantity.   - `inc-keyboard`, `inc-mouse`, `inc-monitor`: buttons that increase the matching item\'s quantity by 1.   - `dec-keyboard`, `dec-mouse`, `dec-monitor`: buttons that decrease the matching item\'s quantity by 1 (not below 0).   - `auto-toggle`: a button that enables / disables the auto-restock feature. - The HTML returned by the server for `/` (i.e. before any client JavaScript executes) MUST already contain the element with `data-testid="total"` showing the correct order total for the current state. A fix that only computes the total on the client is not acceptable. - Reactivity: changing any quantity, or toggling the coupon, must update the `total` text to stay consistent with the current line items and coupon state. - Auto-restock: clicking `auto-toggle` enables the feature, after which the Mouse quantity increases by 1 approximately every 500 ms (and the total stays consistent with it). Clicking `auto-toggle` again disables the feature, after which the Mouse quantity must stop changing immediately with no further (residual) increments. Toggling the feature off and on repeatedly must not cause it to increment more than once per 500 ms interval.  ## Notes - No external services, network calls, databases, or credentials are involved. The reactive wiring is wrong: a task both depends on and writes back to the same reactive state, so during server-side rendering the computed total is not correctly produced/serialized and/or the component spins in a re-run loop, and the auto-restock timer keeps running after it is switched off. Toggling it applies / removes the 10% discount.   - `qty-keyboard`, `qty-mouse`, `qty-monitor`: element whose text content is that item\'s current integer quantity.   - `inc-keyboard`, `inc-mouse`, `inc-monitor`: buttons that increase the matching item\'s quantity by 1.   - `dec-keyboard`, `dec-mouse`, `dec-monitor`: buttons that decrease the matching item\'s quantity by 1 (not below 0).   - `auto-toggle`: a button that enables / disables the auto-restock feature. - The HTML returned by the server for `/` (i.e. before any client JavaScript executes) MUST already contain the element with `data-testid="total"` showing the correct order total for the current state. A fix that only computes the total on the client is not acceptable. - Reactivity: changing any quantity, or toggling the coupon, must update the `total` text to stay consistent with the current line items and coupon state. - Auto-restock: clicking `auto-toggle` enables the feature, after which the Mouse quantity increases by 1 approximately every 500 ms (and the total stays consistent with it). Clicking `auto-toggle` again disables the feature, after which the Mouse quantity must stop changing immediately with no further (residual) increments. Toggling the feature off and on repeatedly must not cause it to increment more than once per 500 ms interval.  ## Notes - No external services, network calls, databases, or credentials are involved.
